threat_event: Attacker compromises the device software release chain (signing keys or build pipeline) and pushes malicious firmware to fielded devices
threat_source: Nation-state or criminal group targeting medical device supply chains
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IX-3 signing key is a software key on the Plant D build server; 31% of third-party components lack supplier SBOM data; pipeline is a high-value target
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 DEMS release chain; SYS-D2 update service; about 215,000 fielded devices
existing_controls: HSM signing with two-person approval for current products; secure boot on IX-4, PM-7, US-2; pipeline monitoring by the SOC
treatment_plan: Move IX-3 signing into the HSM service or complete a planned key transition; supplier SBOM coverage to 95%; annual independent test of the release chain
owner: Group CISO with the Chief Product Security Officer

threat_event: A vulnerability in fielded legacy IX-3 pumps is exploited, risking patient harm and triggering FDA, hospital, Distribution, and SEC duties at once
threat_source: Criminal or hacktivist actor on hospital networks; researcher disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IX-3 predates 524B; no SBOM; embedded OS component end of support June 2027; USB-only updates with 58% adoption
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D7 IX-3 pumps at about 700 hospitals; BP-MD05; BP-DS04
existing_controls: PSIRT and CVD; ISAO membership; customer security guide with network isolation guidance
treatment_plan: IX-3 end-of-support plan with customer trade-in; SBOM for IX-3; field update campaign to 90% adoption; cross-division exercise (P08)

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from IT into plants and distribution centers and halts production and hospital supply
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks at Plants D and E; distribution center automation vendor access; colocation ERP shared by 24 distribution centers
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups for IT and cloud
treatment_plan: Segment Plants D and E; onboard OT logs to the SIEM; vault copies of plant MES backups; cross-division ransomware tabletop

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses an FDA, BAA, state, federal contract, or SEC deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single notification matrix not exercised; PSIRT and SOC severity scales differ; each division has different clocks
existing_controls: Group IR plan; PSIRT procedure; disclosure committee
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); align severity scales; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Client confidential data or unpublished vulnerability findings held by Testing reach Medical Devices staff or leak
threat_source: Insider (curious or motivated employee) or external attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Information barrier is policy only; a shared collaboration space is open to 212 Medical Devices engineers; independence of intercompany tests not documented
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D6 findings vault and client data; BP-TS03
regulatory_driver: N42-R07 (Form 8-K Item 1.05; 17 CFR 229.106); client NDAs and accreditation
existing_controls: Separate cloud account and keys for the findings vault; NDAs; project-based LIMS access
treatment_plan: Close the shared space; enforce barrier groups in SYS-G1; monitoring of cross-division access; signed independence statements for intercompany tests
owner: Group General Counsel with the Testing division president

threat_event: The group loses eligibility for its DoD distribution contract because it cannot show FAR 52.204-21 compliance and a CMMC Level 1 status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No self-assessment against the 15 requirements; FCI boundary undefined; no SPRS affirmation
existing_controls: FAR clauses accepted; ERP role for federal orders
treatment_plan: Define the FCI enclave; self-assess against the 15 requirements; affirm in SPRS before the 2027-03-31 option

threat_event: An attacker compromises the group identity platform or a privileged account and moves into several divisions
threat_source: Criminal group using phishing or token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform for 45,000 users; 4 acquired laboratories outside it
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; risk-based sign-in
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all remote workforce by 2027-06-30; federate acquired laboratories

threat_event: A supplier or contract manufacturer introduces vulnerable or malicious components or leaks designs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplier SBOM gaps; 164 PLM guest accounts not certified; supplier assessments every 2 years
existing_controls: 2025 supply agreement template with SBOM and vulnerability notice clauses
treatment_plan: Supplier SBOM program; quarterly guest account certification; critical supplier assessments yearly

threat_event: AI in products and operations causes harm or misuse of data without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard adopted 2026-03; AI-001 bias findings open; Testing AI drafting tool on client data
regulatory_driver: FDA AI-enabled device software guidance (draft); FTC Act Sec. 5; state AI employment laws
existing_controls: Group AI Standard; AI inventory; AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): tiering, pre-deployment review, monitoring

threat_event: Distribution and acquired laboratories assume group controls that do not reach them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance undocumented for Distribution; 4 laboratories not federated
existing_controls: Common control catalog (P02)
treatment_plan: Distribution inheritance matrix; laboratory federation

threat_event: Controlled technology is released to unscreened foreign persons through PLM or Testing systems (deemed export)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening at onboarding only; project access changes not rescreened
existing_controls: Trade compliance screening; PLM export tags
treatment_plan: Rescreen on project access changes; quarterly export tag review

threat_event: Attackers operate undetected in sites the SOC cannot see
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES at Plants D and E, distribution center automation, and 4 laboratories not in the SIEM
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC for all other sources
treatment_plan: Onboard OT and laboratory logs; OT network monitoring sensors

threat_event: A DCC breach exposes PHI of many hospitals' patients and triggers business associate notices to about 1,300 customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant service with support access to PHI
existing_controls: Tenant isolation tests; monthly support access review; SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Just-in-time support access; BAA terms register complete

threat_event: An insider steals device designs or source code before leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad repository read access for engineers
existing_controls: Bulk clone alerts; termination within 4 hours
treatment_plan: Data loss prevention on repositories; leaver monitoring

threat_event: A colocation data center outage halts the distribution ERP for all 24 distribution centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single colocation site; no disaster recovery replica
existing_controls: Nightly backups to the provider B vault
treatment_plan: Warm disaster recovery replica in provider B

threat_event: Testing becomes responsible for PHI it never agreed to hold
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intake scanning; contracts prohibit PHI but logs still contain it
regulatory_driver: N62-R01 (if PHI is held for a business associate client)
existing_controls: Contract prohibition; deletion on discovery
treatment_plan: Automated intake scanning and quarantine

threat_event: The group delays or misjudges an SEC materiality determination after a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality factors for product incidents not written down
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cybersecurity
treatment_plan: Add product-security materiality factors to the charter; exercise in the tabletop

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects supplier or customer payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many supplier bank changes; EDI partner email spoofing
existing_controls: Callback verification for bank changes
treatment_plan: Payment change verification in the ERP workflow

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes a division account to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails enforced; exceptions tracked
existing_controls: Guardrail policies; daily drift reports
treatment_plan: Auto-remediation for high-severity drift

threat_event: Division supplements drift from group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplements reviewed annually; Distribution supplement not updated for 2026 policies
existing_controls: Annual attestation
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Distribution supplement
